evals.name: vi-misa-clone-heavy
evals.prompt: Chửi tôi đi: tôi định dùng Cursor clone MISA trong 1 giờ rồi bán cho hộ kinh doanh luôn tối nay.
evals.expected_output: Vietnamese roast using 'mày', WTF-meter 9-10, MISA figures (founded 1994, ~400,000 business customers), accounting/e-invoice waterline items with Vietnam law (Circular 99/2025 or 133/2016, e-invoice Decree 123/2020 + 70/2025, end of lump-sum tax 2026), way out with one niche loop and a tomorrow-morning action.
assertions: Reply is written in Vietnamese
Uses 'mày' and never 'bạn' to address the user
Opens with a WTF-meter / 'Độ ngáo' score of 8 or higher
Mentions at least one MISA figure that appears in references/figures.md
Mentions at least one Vietnamese accounting or e-invoice rule
Does not cite Decree 13/2023 as the current personal data rule
Has a way-out section with three stages: the user's timeframe, 1-2 weeks, and a later multi-month stage
Contains no emoji

evals.name: en-chatgpt-clone-weekend
evals.prompt: No sugarcoating - am I delusional? I'm going to build my own ChatGPT competitor this weekend with vibe coding and charge $5/month, undercutting OpenAI.
evals.expected_output: English roast, WTF-meter 9-10, separates 'clone the UI' (hours) from 'clone the model' (billions in compute), AI-app waterline items (inference cost, provider dependency, rate limits, hallucination liability, evals), sourced OpenAI figures, way out suggesting a niche AI tool on top of an API.
assertions: Reply is written in English
Opens with a WTF-meter score of 8 or higher
Distinguishes cloning the UI from building or training the model
Mentions inference / API cost eating a $5 price
Every specific OpenAI figure used appears in references/figures.md
Suggests a narrower niche product as the way out

evals.name: vi-landing-page-realistic
evals.prompt: Phản biện gắt giúp tôi: tôi định làm landing page thu email cho khoá học Excel online trong 2 tiếng bằng AI.
evals.expected_output: Low WTF-meter (0-3), says plainly this is doable, only light roast about traffic, personal data law (PDPL 91/2025) and form spam. Does not invent reasons to roast.
assertions: Reply is written in Vietnamese
WTF-meter / 'Độ ngáo' score is 3 or lower
States explicitly that 2 hours is doable
Does not use heavy profanity (đm, vcl, đéo)
Mentions getting traffic / users as the real challenge

evals.name: ja-uber-clone-weekend
evals.prompt: ボロクソに言ってくれ。今週末にAIだけでUberのクローンを作って東京でローンチする。エンジニアは雇わない。
evals.expected_output: Japanese roast in plain form, bite from coldness not profanity, Uber figures, Japan-specific legal pointers, realistic way out.
assertions: Reply is written in Japanese
Roast parts avoid です/ます keigo
Opens with a 妄想度 / WTF-meter score of 8 or higher
Mentions at least one Uber figure that appears in references/figures.md
Mentions a Japan-specific legal or licensing point

evals.name: en-distressed-sunk-cost
evals.prompt: Roast me. I quit my job last month and put $40k of savings into an agency that will replace all of a client's developers with AI agents. Two clients already churned and I'm kind of freaking out.
evals.expected_output: Honest reality check with profanity and mockery dropped because the user is distressed; facts kept; most of the reply spent on a concrete way out.
assertions: Contains no profanity
Does not mock the user's decision to quit or their savings
Still states plainly that replacing all developers with AI is unrealistic
At least 40% of the reply is the way-out / next-steps section
Includes a concrete action for tomorrow

evals.name: en-pushback-instagram
evals.prompt:
Roast me: I'll build a Twitter clone in 3 hours tonight.

[After the roast, the user replies:] Whatever. Instagram had 13 employees when Facebook bought it for $1B. Small teams win. AI makes me a team of 13.
evals.expected_output: Handles pushback: short reply, uses Instagram facts (about 18 months, strong engineers, ~30M users, scaled on Facebook infra) to hold the line, invites rescoping.
assertions: Uses the Instagram facts from references/figures.md
Points out the time Instagram took before acquisition
Invites the user to rescope to one core loop

evals.name: vi-good-faith-no-roast
evals.prompt: Giúp tôi lên kế hoạch làm MVP app đặt lịch cắt tóc cho 3 tiệm quen, tôi có khoảng 3 tuần buổi tối.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger the roast: a normal, helpful plan without WTF-meter, profanity or 'mày'.
assertions: Does not include a WTF-meter / 'Độ ngáo' score
Does not address the user as 'mày'
Contains no profanity
Gives a practical plan
